title: お祝いの料理
subject_en: Celebration dishes served on plates and in lacquer bowls, cute and friendly, each ONE dish centred in its cell Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ちらし寿司・赤飯・鯛・ローストチキンなど、お祝いの席に並ぶ料理12点です。行事のお知らせやメニュー表に使えます。
items: a round wooden tub of scattered sushi topped with egg strands, shrimp, salmon roe and snow peas
a bowl of red sekihan rice with black sesame and a sprig of nanten leaf
a whole red sea bream grilled and served on an oval plate with greens
five round temari sushi balls in pastel colours on a small plate
shrimp and vegetable tempura piled on a plate with a dipping cup
a whole roast chicken on a platter with herbs and potatoes
a lidded cup of chawanmushi with the lid slightly open and steam rising
a bowl of simmered carrot, lotus root and shiitake cut in flower shapes
a lacquer bowl of clam soup with a clam shell and a wisp of steam
a small bowl of red and white shredded daikon and carrot salad
a large round wooden sushi platter with assorted nigiri
a round strawberry cake with whipped cream and a small flag on top
